description: run cloud browsers from chatgpt. KERNEL gives your agent a real browser with full access to the internet: it can open any site, read and click through pages, fill out forms, and take screenshots. when a task needs one of your accounts, you sign in through a secure login panel that keeps passwords out of chat. each session runs in its own isolated cloud browser and shuts down when the task is done.

defaultPrompt: search the KERNEL docs and explain when browser profile changes are saved
list my deployed KERNEL apps and show their latest deployments
start a cloud browser at example.com and take a screenshot
